content:
Ravi Singh: Quick notes from Spiral-7B onboarding smoke. ran int8/int4 + short routing pilot against GTN-slice-9. need a product-ready rec.
Nina Gomez: Short summary: int8 quality ~ -1.1 pts vs fp16, int4 ~ -3.7 pts. cost estimates: fp16 $0.50/1k, int8 $0.14/1k, int4 $0.035/1k.
Liam Ortiz: Failure modes: long chains (>1k tokens) and numerically-sensitive tables. int4 has more hallucination in table extraction tasks.
Ravi Singh: Proposal for GTN:
- Default: Spiral-7B-int8
- Opportunistic int4 when: prompt length < 400 tokens AND classifier predicts low-risk
- Pin fp16 for top 1% revenue flows (billing/legal)
Expected effective cost ~ $0.10/1k tokens.
Nina Gomez: Canary plan: 4% traffic split: 2% int8 baseline, 1% int4-opportunistic, 1% fp16 pinned. monitor GTN-quality, longform-regressions, p95-latency. rollback if regressions > 2%.
CI Bot: artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-eval/spiral7b/onboard-pilot-2026-03/
Liam Ortiz: I'll share the 120 failure examples and per-task deltas in the artifact.
Ravi Singh: Thanks all. Nina will draft the 1-pager for GTN based on this. follow-up thread for 24h canary metrics.
